sections.title: Software Testing Services in Indore – FAQs

items.q: What exactly do your Software Testing Services in Indore include?
items.a: Our Software Testing Services include manual testing, automation testing, API testing, performance testing, security testing, and mobile app testing for both Android and iOS platforms.

items.q: Do you provide automation testing services for CI/CD pipelines?
items.a: Yes. We build custom automation frameworks using Selenium, Cypress, and Playwright that integrate seamlessly with Jenkins, GitLab CI, and other DevOps tools for continuous testing.

items.q: How do you ensure security testing for web applications?
items.a: We follow OWASP standards and perform vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and authentication flaw detection to identify and fix security risks before deployment.

items.q: Can you test my existing legacy software?
items.a: Absolutely. We specialize in testing legacy systems, identifying hidden bugs, and recommending fixes without disrupting your ongoing operations.

items.q: Do you offer post-launch testing support?
items.a: Yes. We provide ongoing regression testing, maintenance support, and testing for new feature releases as part of our long-term QA partnership.
